title: feat(research): compose restore and packing gains
body:
## Summary

Compose Jeremy Kothe's PR3015 restore edit with PR3018's improving allocation journal. The fresh complete finite release gives

```text
PR3015:  0.001729150973534224428695 - 10^-46 - 10^-70
composed:0.001729151203983018442998 - 10^-46 - 10^-70
gain:    230448794014303 / 10^24
```

The composed complete profile is `{1:1644352, 2:470862, 3:159472, 4:71928, 5:13710, 8:5328, 14:1, 48:28190}`. Every one of 271,728 roles, 91 private buffers and 66,813 physical families remains charged. The one changed scientific recipe argument is admission's `--fill`. PR3015's scalar words and source manifest remain exact; its rederived cleanup is retained.

The package `research/rank7-restore-packing-composition` includes the proof, exact source blobs, journal, bounded verifier, full recipe and fresh receipts. Scientific sources are PR3015 `e244296debb45fe6f4da84d29e4d64fbab55fda0` and PR3018 `ca7113157d7c959fdfa9d7cd17ef92d3877070d0`. Base main and submission checkpoint are `d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641`, priority revision 6. [Canonical coordination and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18979353).

## Evidence

- Before: PR3015's literal fill and both providers independently reproduce its moment bracket. PR3018's journal was a finite improvement without composed admission.
- After: a 648.30-second fresh bootstrap, both current native-provider chains, owners, parent lift, rebind, strict discovery, independent outer-ledger checks and complete modern outer release pass on the composed fill. The final public wrapper rechecks actual source trees, native/provider bindings, complete profile, fill bytes and the released endpoint. Its stronger postchecks and process cleanup were added while the unchanged scientific recipe ran; a final dry run confirms that same recipe.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay passes, including 16 behavioral tests and four stored-receipt corruption controls. Optimized finite output matches the committed receipt; Ruff correctness/import/bugbear/modernization checks pass. The registered replay checks stored full-release bindings; the README's separate command reruns the complete chain. Hosted CI is separate.

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/rank7-restore-packing-composition
```

R1 credit remains with Jeremy Kothe; the packing journal credit remains with Nick Petalas. The underlying joint rank-7 construction is Marius-Paul Dumitrean's PR2979, with the retained Hale, Diviney, Lu, Tekalign, Richardson, Dugongue, icekylinx, themilkman216 and source lineage. New contribution: composition and source-bound full release. Substantial automated assistance was used; no independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed. Apache-2.0.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated research package.

This is a conditional finite supplier/outer certificate. Inherited all-size/compiler, hosting, precision/tape, analytic and universal block-energy hypotheses remain. The selected frontier and frozen predecessors are unchanged. The inherited fractional cap remains above the candidate; integral optimality is open. Exact overlap coverage and limitations are in `TASK.json`.
